title: Same distances encoded at Roman sites

tellings.quote: of 5,300 m and 2300 m encoded in Roman sites as well and these hillsides that have the same configuration as the White Horse Hills of Wilshire, England.

plain: The same distances, 5,300 metres and 2,300 metres, are built into Roman sites and into hillsides laid out like the White Horse Hills of Wiltshire in England, according to Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher of the pyramids. He tells Michels this from his own study, as a sign that a shared ancient measuring system ran through very different places.
